compliance_decision:
Compliance Answer: Responsible parties must adhere to the FIC Act's accountability obligations as outlined in Section 6123 of Chapter I, Title II - Accountable Institutions and Supervision (FIC-Act).
Relevant Regulatory Basis: Financial Industry Commissioner’s Reference Guide for All Accountable Institutions. FIC Act – Section 6123.
Explanation: Under the FIC Act, responsible parties are required to maintain adequate internal controls and procedures that ensure compliance with all applicable regulations (FIC-Act). They must also report any noncompliance or irregularities detected within their operations immediately to regulatory authorities as mandated by Section 6123.
